newsitem.title: POLAND: BUDIMEX MULLS '96 PAYOUT DESPITE LOWER NET.
newsitem.headline: BUDIMEX MULLS '96 PAYOUT DESPITE LOWER NET.

text.p: The Polish construction company Budimex SA is considering to pay out a dividend for 1996, despite a lower than earlier expected net profit, the firm's spokeswoman said.
Irena Jagielska told Reuters, however, the company had not yet taken any decisions.
"We didn't pay dividends for the last two years, so we are considering it now, but nothing has been decided yet," she said.
Budimex earlier said it was lowering its 1996 net profit forecast to 18-19 million zlotys from 30 million zlotys, because of harsh winter slow-down at the beginning of the year.
